During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Ganga Lor]] operated a '''criminal organization''' that was based on [[Sel Zonn Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Lor led all of the members of his organization in an attack on the headquarters of the [[Switch's organization|rival organization]] of the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Switch]], in [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] of the station. However, Lor and every single member of his organization were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the attack.
